Added: Mobile browser regression checks at densities 1, 2 and 3, repeated rotation and synthetic canvas insets.
Touchscreen taps and swipe scrolling now have a dedicated browser test, including combat, rewards and save/resume.
Changed: Browser layout uses the displayed canvas height while retaining the 1.5 render-density cap.
Existing controls resize after orientation and viewport changes; settings toggles and seed entry share the touch minimum.
Fixed: Dense-phone compact controls measured 41.33 CSS pixels in 0.6.0; minimum touch height is now 44 CSS pixels.
High-density landscape no longer chooses its compact layout from render-buffer pixels.
Browser test input accounts for the actual canvas position and size, including synthetic safe-area padding.
KnownIssues: No physical Android device is connected. Real phones, iOS, native graphical Windows play and audible listening remain unverified.
Browser density, touch and inset tests are emulation; no physical-device performance gain is claimed.
Native safe-area behavior is retained. Gameplay, campaign content and save schema are unchanged.
Unity builds run locally; GitHub validates and publishes prepared players.
Full original-game parity and store release remain unfinished.
Two inherited browser CI inventory failures remain documented and waived for Unity checkpoint work.
WhatToTest: Open the dev game on a dense phone screen and rotate between portrait and landscape.
Tap compact combat controls and settings; they should remain easy to hit.
Inspect intent after rotation, continue combat, then reload and resume.
Compare the denser landscape screenshots and test real mobile browser toolbars/notches on your device.
